Trump Media to offer paid access to social media posts

Donald Trump's media company is reportedly planning to launch a paid data feed, offering financial firms and traders faster access to posts from influential users, including Trump himself. This move could potentially impact global markets. Separately, a White House staffer was accused of profiting from inside knowledge of Trump's speeches.
